hypothesis: applying Phase 2J's fixed feature-cell sampling only to base-label single-target requests (happy, sad, calm, energetic) improves within-mood diversity while avoiding Phase 2J's angry/stressed regression and uplift whole-list diversity loss.

preregistration.routing: T uses Phase 2J strategy S (30 fixed PCA feature cells per target, one production-weighted pick among each chosen cell's 20 most confident available tracks, calm guard) only when the request has exactly one target and it is happy, sad, calm or energetic; every other request is served by G unchanged.
preregistration.reference: G (production + calm guard). Unguarded production is reported alongside.
gates_resolved: Single-target gates use within-target diversity (equal to list diversity for one target).
Calm speech-like share must be <= 0.20 and <= unguarded production's share on the same seeds.

Configurations where T routes to G (angry, stressed, all five multi-target mixes) have paired differences of exactly 0: they count as 'lower bound not > 0' for the 4-of-6 count and pass the no-regression and non-inferiority gates.
The legacy mean classifier probability >= 0.99 is reported, not applied.
Within-target diversity of multi-target requests is reported as a diagnostic only.
preregistration.seeds: Gates are decided on 30000-30049. 33000-33049 is a replication set: it is reported, and any gate it fails is flagged as not replicated. Both are disjoint from every earlier seed set.
preregistration.uncertainty: Paired per-seed differences against G; 2,000-sample percentile bootstrap over 50 runs (family means bootstrap the per-run family mean). Sampling variability on one catalog only.

gates.integrity: 100% target consistency, exact shares in every list, same-seed determinism on all 12 requests

measured_facts: Which tracks are served, their dataset label / derived-rule membership, exact target shares, repeat rate, unique-track coverage, determinism and latency in this harness.
Audio-feature values (Spotify-derived) and the classifier's probabilities for served tracks.
proxies: Feature-space diversity (mean pairwise distance in 9 z-scored audio features) is a proxy for variety; it is not listener-perceived variety and is inflated by outliers such as speech-like tracks.

Classifier probability and agreement are proxies for mood relevance; the classifier was trained on the same model-generated labels and the ranking optimises its probability, so they are not independent.
Target consistency is circular: candidates are filtered by the same label/rule that defines relevance.
Typicality (distance to the target's eligible centroid) describes where in the mood's feature distribution picks come from; whether central or extreme tracks are 'better' is not measured.
assumptions: The Moodify labels (model-generated, CC BY 4.0) are an acceptable definition of each base mood.
Angry and stressed percentile rules define those moods (stressed is experimental).
More within-mood variety at constant relevance is desirable; no user data confirms this.
measurement_validity.not_measured: No human relevance judgments, listening data, skips, likes or A/B outcomes exist for this catalog; nothing here measures listener satisfaction.

notes: Diversity is feature-space diversity, not listener-perceived variety.
Bootstrap intervals describe sampling variability over 50 seeded runs on one catalog only.
Latency is machine-dependent; T's cells are built once per catalog (cell_build_ms), not per request.
